newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading with a few fresh deals reported in the afternoon, traders said on Thursday.
They said European buyers bought rubber at 48.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for July shipment, at 48.125 for August shipment and at 47.75 fob Jakarta for July shipment.
"Demand keeps coming into the market. But many traders believe it's better for them to wait a little bit longer to raise offer prices because supply is tight," said one trader.
"We expect offer prices to improve tomorrow because of this bullish trend," said another trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 48.50 fob Belawan, 48.00 fob Padang and 47.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
